text: I can trace one decode step from token ID through embedding, attention and MLP blocks, the LM head and the sampler, and say where the KV cache is read and written.
I can estimate FLOPs per token as 2 × parameters and compute a GPU's ridge point from its peak FLOP/s and memory bandwidth.
I can show with numbers why prefill is compute-bound, why decode is bandwidth-bound, and why batching stops scaling once KV-cache reads dominate.
I can compute temperature-scaled probabilities by hand and say which tokens survive a given top-k or top-p setting.
I can explain why temperature 0 drifts on a shared endpoint (non-associative floating point, batch-variant kernels, MoE routing) and propose mitigations with their costs.
